name: freshness-differences-precondition-labels-solo
body: The four precondition labels (`database`, `socket`, `git sha`, `recorded scan`) are reported alone, so a precondition failure never also lists the collected inputs. `database`, `git sha` and `recorded scan` are alone because the remaining inputs cannot be evaluated without them; `socket` is alone by the untrusted-DB phantom-projection contract — after an unclean session exit the on-disk DB cannot be trusted until a rebuild, even though its rows are readable and the other inputs are computable. Upgrade by enumerating a precondition label in an e2e test only if that pairing becomes a contract.
